shared_context: Petersfield Secondary School has scheduled a curriculum-change town hall. Invitations were sent to 120 parents. The school has a standard RSVP mechanism (e.g., email, online form, or phone). The Friday before the event is 2026-10-16. The simulation starts on 2026-10-05.

starting_events.description: The school administration has sent invitations to 120 parents for the curriculum-change town hall. No RSVPs have been received yet.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that more than 60 distinct parents (i.e., > half of 120) have sent an RSVP (either yes or no) to the school by 2026-10-16T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
